svg.text: Review perspective — the editor in AAR with the Replay Browser's analysis windows (DESIGN_Review_Perspective.md)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
the map — the editor's ONE world, replaying (context)
★ the search's hits and a data breakpoint's stops become timeline lanes; a click seeks there
Merged · 4 participants (CGF ×2, SimHost, Player) — step / scrub
★ ONE AAR (D1). The SOURCE follows the files: a group opens MERGED, said in the status bar (D9). The TRANSPORT is the Replay Browser's one drawer (D8) —
history, step back / forward with scrub, the seek bar; ▶ greyed while merged (step / scrub only). The LAYOUT (Scenario · Review) only docks windows.
★ Search, frame diff and the change finder read the FILES in throwaway readers — no second visible world. Review switches in by itself on an all-in-one AAR
or a group (D10); switching to Scenario mid-AAR keeps the replay, the source, the status bar and the transport.
Unchanged, drawn as context: the indicator (AQ108 §0), the rules bundle, Details, the Event Timeline's own lanes. Seat · hat moved to the status bar (CE-4329).
How you get into Review (§3a) — opening a recording for analysis switches the layout; the indicator ▸ Edit switches back
Recent ▸ AAR = the scenario's latest run
AAR — full replay of this exercise
leave: the indicator ▸ Edit — the layout you had comes back · the Scenario / Review buttons change only the layout, never the mode ·
a real cluster's AAR (the trainees' debrief) never switches by itself
